description: Live desync from conv_8201m22mqqnafgza85n87yx7csbg: the shipping question came back as a tool result but was never actually spoken to the patient, and the very next advance_scheduling call arrived with `message` set to that exact question text instead of a real reply. Its own wording ('...pick one up yourself at a pharmacy...') matches shipping.ts's DECLINE_PATTERN, so unguarded this silently marks the shipping gate answered with no address before the patient ever heard the ask. sessions.ts's echo guard (appendTurn's isEchoOfLastAgentTurn) must recognize a patient turn that verbatim-echoes Daphne's own immediately preceding line, skip extraction/decide entirely, and re-ask the identical question rather than treating it as a decline. See docs/bug-investigation-conv_8201m22mqqnafgza85n87yx7csbg.md.
